resources.string: Turn your idea into a 30-second animated reel.

Six AI scenes, joined into one silent reel. Scene transitions may be visible. Without an uploaded image, AI creates one from your prompt using extra GPU quota. Free access has queues and a shared daily quota, so a reel may need more than one day. Your prompt and any uploaded image are sent to Hugging Face.
Your six-scene timeline will appear here.
